title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Criar análises e relatórios a partir de diferentes fontes de dados, com foco em gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Construir e manter modelos de dados eficientes (camadas analíticas, camada semantica, views, data marts).
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como DBT, SQL, Python e ambientes como BigQuery ou Redshift.
  • Criar e documentar transformações de dados com boas práticas de versionamento e testes.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados, analistas e product managers para garantir dados confiáveis.
  • Desenvolver dashboards (ex: Metabase, Looker) para visualização de métricas e KPIs.
  • Apoiar a criação de pequenos modelos preditivos ou análises estatísticas simples quando necessário.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de transformação de dados como DBT ou equivalente.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises exploratórias e criar relatórios com storytelling.
  • Noções de Python para análises e automações básicas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto e negócio: entender o "porquê" por trás dos dados.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de versionamento e qualidade de dados.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Experiência com modelos preditivos simples (ex: churn, scoring, clustering).
  • Experiência em ambientes com DataOps ou MLOps.
  • Conhecimento em testes de dados (ex: dbt tests, Great Expectations).
  • Experiência explorando e analisando dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, entendendo as demandas do negócio por meio de conversas com stakeholders.
  • Vivência traduzindo os resultados por meio de relatórios e dashboards em ferramentas como Looker ou Metabase.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique pelo LinkedIn

title: PERM Project Manager
description:
PERM Project Manager


*Please note this is an administrative, non-technical project coordination role.*


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


This Project Manager position will join the PERM Advertising team. The PERM Advertising team provides U.S. immigration-based recruitment advertising and consulting services to U.S. lawyers and law firms.


A PERM Project Manager will support clients with the planning, organization, and execution of advertising projects. This is an administrative, non-technical role focused on scheduling, documentation, communication, and ensuring smooth day-to-day project operations. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, and skilled at coordinating across teams and stakeholders to keep projects on track.


This is a fully remote position. Working hours will be in Eastern Standard Time (United States time zone). Fluency in spoken and written English is required as you will be collaborating with U.S.-based team members and clients.


Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects
  • Quality assurance functions that involve the careful review of documents for accuracy and consistency
  • Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time and within scope
  • Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools and techniques
  • Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders
  • Manage all lifecycle stages for a project from ideation through sunset, with responsibility for ensuring that deliverables are understood and releases are delivered on time.


Requirements:

  • Strong educational background
  • Proven working experience in an environment that required close attention to detail
  • The ability to balance multiple ongoing projects
  • Clear, effective communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, as well as with remote teams
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • English proficiency both written and spoken
  • Access to reliable internet

title: Líder Técnico (Aplicações .NET)
description:
A vaga é remoto contudo, haverá reuniões de trabalho presencial em Porto Alegre, de forma eventual ou seja, disponível para viagens.


Principais responsabilidades:

• Atuar na sustentação de aplicações .NET, analisando incidentes e propondo soluções definitivas, não apenas tratativas paliativas;

• Realizar investigações de código (inclusive engenharia reversa quando necessário) para identificar falhas em sistemas legados e corrigi-las;

• Corrigir bugs, implementar melhorias e desenvolver soluções técnicas em conjunto com o time;

• Ser referência técnica, orientando a squad quanto à qualidade das soluções, sem limitar-se apenas à coordenação;

• Apoiar testes e homologações em ambientes controlados, garantindo a estabilidade da operação;

• Participar dos rituais ágeis da squad, contribuindo com visão técnica sólida.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

• Experiência sólida com .NET Framework e/ou .NET Core;

• Conhecimentos de Arquitetura em ambientes cloud (Azure/AWS), ferramentas de monitoramento e boas práticas de observabilidade.

• Proficiência em C#, APIs REST e SQL Server;

• Vivência prévia em sustentação ou suporte de sistemas críticos;

• Capacidade analítica para investigar falhas e propor soluções estruturais;

• Boa comunicação e postura colaborativa, atuando como referência técnica.


Diferenciais:

• Experiência com Git e pipelines de CI/CD;

• Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);

• Inglês básico/intermediário para leitura técnica;

• Perfil mão na massa, proativo e com senso de dono, assumindo responsabilidades e entregando soluções.


Idioma: Inglês ou Espanhol Avançado (desejável).


Modelo de contratação: CLT + benefícios.

title: Implementation/Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Implementation / Forward Deployed Engineer - Canada, Mexico, South America - Remote


About us

VERSA AI is an innovative and fast-growing start-up in the Contact Center automation space - designing and deploying next generation voice Ai Agents. We’re on a mission to build and support the Contact Center of the future using the power of Ai to create beautiful conversations between humans and machines.


Our technology helps clients deliver exceptional customer experiences whilst simultaneously cutting costs and managing growth. An Australian-founded business with a strong foothold in the US, we are looking to expand our operations and build out our team on the ground in this critical market. We are looking for passionate, entrepreneurial individuals who are eager to make a significant impact in a dynamic and fast-moving environment.


Who we are looking for

A versatile Full Stack Engineer who can move from discovery to delivery with minimal hand-holding. You are strongest in Node.js on AWS, comfortable with IaC, and fluent in stitching together APIs, LLMs, SIP telephony and cloud services to ship reliable, production value fast. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and write clear, testable code. You enjoy working directly with clients, translating goals into pragmatic workflows, then owning the build, rollout and measurement. You communicate crisply with both engineers and non-technical partners, collaborate with internal stakeholders, and leave things better than you found them through improved tooling, documentation and dashboards.


Required Experience:

  • 5 - 8 years of professional engineering experience, ideally across full-stack development and you have a strong understanding of engineering principles.
  • Strong background in system integration, workflow automation, and API-driven development utilising Node.js and AWS.
  • Proven ability to work directly with clients and colleagues, build trust, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with a high level of autonomy. Working independently is highly important in this role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Integration between LLM’s, SIP Telephony, API endpoints and cloud infrastructure (AWS) using mostly NodeJs and IAC.
  • Partner with clients to design and implement automation workflows that align with their roadmap upon onboarding of new clients.
  • Develop, integrate, and maintain full-stack features to deliver immediate value in production.
  • Act as both engineer and consultant: uncovering client challenges, advising on solutions, and building them in collaboration with the clients technical team.
  • Collaborate internally with the Customer Success and Conversation Design teams to translate to technical requirements and ensure seamless delivery.
  • Contribute to improving internal tooling, documentation and frameworks for faster client implementations.


What success looks like

In the first 30 days you will map our architecture, run the product locally and in staging, and set yourself up with logs and monitoring. You will close a first batch of low risk tickets, ship a couple of small peer-reviewed fixes, and improve at least one run book.

In the next few months, you will be a trusted technical support partner who triages and resolves incidents end to end, consistently meets SLAs, and owns a service area with clear dashboards and documentation. You will reduce repeat issues through small automations or fixes, contribute to RCAs, and share knowledge with the team.


The benefits

The Versa Group has been recognised both in Australia and internationally for

creating a highly innovative environment for our employees. In 2019 Versa were

named as only one of eight companies outside of the US in Fast Company’s Top 50

Workplaces for Innovators.

  • Be part of a fast-growing start-up with a dynamic and innovative culture.
  • Opportunity for significant professional growth and career advancement.
  • Competitive salary and commission structure.
  • Highly flexible work environment with a ‘remote first’ company

We believe that diversity is critical to our success. We will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

title: Sênior FRONT END
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Analista fiscal Junior
description:
ANALISTA FISCAL JUNIOR

Quer transformar a contabilidade em um diferencial competitivo? Vem com a gente!


Na C-Controll Contabilidade , a gente acredita que a rotina fiscal pode ser mais estratégica do que burocrática. Procuramos um(a) Analista Fiscal Júnior com vontade de aprender, crescer e contribuir para transformar o dia a dia dos nossos clientes.


Sobre a C-Controll

Somos uma contabilidade que pensa diferente. Ajudamos empresas e empresários a tomarem decisões melhores com informações confiáveis, práticas e descomplicadas.


Conheça mais:

➡️ Site oficial (

Instagram (


O que você vai fazer:

• Realizar a escrituração fiscal de empresas do Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido, Simples Nacional e Produtor Rural;

• Efetuar a apuração de tributos (PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS e outros);

• Elaborar e transmitir obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Reinf, etc);

• Manter o relacionamento com o cliente ativo e consultivo;

• Garantir a conformidade fiscal e apoiar no planejamento tributário.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.

title: Tech Lead .NET/React
description:
Procuramos um(a) profissional experiente, capaz de aliar liderança técnica, capacidade de decisão e atuação hands-on em projetos estratégicos. O(a) candidato(a) deverá ter perfil proativo, autonomia e excelente comunicação, além de sólida experiência com as tecnologias desejadas.


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Liderança de squads, incluindo orientação, acompanhamento e desenvolvimento dos membros do time
  • Revisão de códigos legados e coordenação de melhorias
  • Condução de reuniões técnicas e participação ativa em discussões de arquitetura de software
  • Resolução de bugs críticos em ambiente de produção
  • Proposição de soluções preventivas para evitar falhas futuras
  • Execução de demandas estratégicas solicitadas pela empresa


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead (preferencialmente com histórico de liderança de times ou squads)
  • Inglês avançado para conversação
  • Experiência com design de software
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de ecommerce em larga escala

Profundo conhecimento em:

  • React
  • .NET
  • C#
  • ASP.NET Core
  • Azure


Diferencial:

  • Experiência na passagem de ReactJS para NextJS, virtual DOM, Redux, Hooks, triggers, Redis Cache, LINQ to SQL
  • Capacidade de avaliar o tempo real de atuação dos candidatos nas tecnologias citadas e o nível de profundidade técnica


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Calypso Front Office Business Analyst
description:
Why Join Qaracter


Qaracter is an international consulting firm specialized in the financial and banking sector. We partner with leading institutions to drive transformation projects across compliance, technology, operations, and risk management.


With a global mindset and strong expertise in financial services, we help our clients face complex challenges and design innovative solutions.


What powers it all? Our people — ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.



What You’ll Do

  • Work with trade capture, pricing, simulation reports, sensitivities
  • Support front office modules including P&L, risk, compliance, and market data
  • Contribute to curve and product definitions, trade blotters, and limit setups
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders and deliver under tight deadlines



What You Bring

  • 5+ years in finance industry projects, ideally in capital markets
  • Hands-on Calypso experience across front office functions
  • Strong planning, communication, and analytical skills
  • Degree in Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Proficiency in Java, SQL, and scripting


Location

LATAM (Remote).



Your Benefits at Qaracter

  • Opportunity to work on international financial projects.
  • Flexibility: remote, hybrid, or in-office options depending on the client.
  • Recognition and referral programs.
  • Ongoing learning and training opportunities with reimbursement options.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Project Manager at Mosaic Puzzles. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the company's project portfolio, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely and successful project delivery. They will also be responsible for developing project plans, monitoring progress, and addressing any issues that arise.


Role Responsibilities

  • Run and oversee project management and program management functions across the entire company
  • Manage business operations internal to the organization
  • Manage trade shows and holiday market events (staffing, logistics, planning)
  • Travel to the United States as needed for trade shows and events
  • Run annual and quarterly planning for the company
  • Set the pace and ensure all stakeholders are accountable to timelines
  • Determine departmental KPIs for annual and quarterly goal setting


Qualifications

  • Project Management, Program Management, and Team Leadership skills
  • Strategic Planning and Decision-Making abilities
  • Excellent Communication and Interpersonal skills
  • Cost benefit analysis skills
  • Analytical skills
  • Design skills a plus
  • Risk Management and Problem-Solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or related field
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) is a plus
  • 7-15 years of project management experience


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Wind Project Manager Brazil
description:
Job Tittle: Project Manager
Department: TSI Project Management (Turbine, Service and Installation)
Location: Brazil
Job Responsibility
1)Leading the project team's activities to safely deliver,install and commission wind turbines on schedule and within budget.
2) Manage customer relationship and act as focal point for the escalation of project issues and roadblocks
3) Support the project delivery according to business and contract commitments of Envision Energy
4) Ensure the coherence of PM reporting to Envision Energy leadership
5) Contribute proactively to the safety culture of the project
Job Qualification
1) Qualification in relevant field, engineering or project management
2) Minimum 5 years' experience as Project manager on major infrastructure projects for
well-known enterprises, leading a team of Project Managers
3) Minimum 5 years' experience as Project Manager prior to Project Direct or level managing large infrastructure projects with a particular focus on wind farms
4) Experience in wind industry is mandatory
5) Knowledge in people and project management methods and techniques, commercial
management.
6) The courage to challenge, the continuous pursuit of success and higher standards.

title: JD Edwards Developer - English and Spanish - Remote
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working ""hands-on"" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Fluent in Spanish and English

• Availability to work CST timezone


Desired :

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de alguém energético, proativo e com visão de crescimento para integrar o time do Ecossistema Octo .

Nosso propósito é apoiar empresas na construção e desenvolvimento de ecossistemas de parceiros, oferecendo soluções como treinamento online, imersões executivas, mentorias, advisory e comunidade . Agora queremos levar esse impacto para ainda mais pessoas e negócios.


O que você vai fazer:
  • Atender leads gerados pelo marketing e indicações e qualificá-los.
  • Prospecção ativa em redes sociais
  • Conduzir conversas comerciais consultivas (telefone, videochamada, WhatsApp, e-mail).
  • Mapear necessidades e direcionar para a solução mais adequada (treinamento, imersão, advisory, mentoria etc).
  • Organizar o CRM e manter atualizado.
  • Acompanhar o funil de vendas e apoiar no pós-venda inicial
  • Trabalhar o relacionamento com nossa comunidade de Octobuilders para identificar oportunidades de novas ofertas


O que buscamos:
  • Perfil mão na massa, proativo e ágil
  • Boa comunicação (oral e escrita).
  • Organização e disciplina no acompanhamento de leads.
  • Vontade de crescer junto com o Ecossistema Octo (não precisa ter muita experiência em vendas B2B, mas sim disposição para aprender).


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas ou em educação/serviços B2B.
  • Interesse por temas como inovação, startups, ecossistemas, parcerias e comunidades.


O que oferecemos:
  • Trabalho remoto.
  • Salário fixo + variável atrativo (modelo híbrido fixo + comissionamento).
  • Espaço para aprendizado, crescimento rápido e exposição em uma rede de alto nível.
  • Fazer parte de um movimento que conecta líderes e empresas em torno de parcerias e ecossistemas.
